fusions.name: Underfoot Rush
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles at the target, then the blow deals 12 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crumb Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a chip of rubble that deals 3 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hole in the Skirting
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later and you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Skirting Board Route
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
